name: memova
description: Create a Personal Manual, use Knowledge V5, and run Memova workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create a Personal Manual and use private Memova workflows.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP for explicit Personal Manual generation, bounded Knowledge V5 retrieval, reviewed memory proposals, automation workflows, and selected-content import. The Personal Manual workflow reads only a bounded task set approved by the user, locally filters it to user/assistant text, creates matching Markdown and standalone HTML, and uploads only those final files after preview confirmation. It never runs in the background.
defaultPrompt: Search and use my Memova Knowledge V5.
